description: This file contains a PHP implementation of an Oracle ('oci8quercus') database driver and associated Recordset class for the ADOdb abstraction layer, specifically tailored for the Quercus environment. It defines driver classes, includes external dependencies, and implements methods for fetching field metadata.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8quercus
classes.description: A driver class extending ADODB_oci8 for the 'oci8quercus' database type, setting data provider.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8quercus
classes.description: A Recordset class extending ADORecordset_oci8, customized for the 'oci8quercus' database driver, including a method for field metadata extraction.

methods.name: _FetchField
methods.description: Fetches metadata about a database field at a specified offset, including name, type, length, scale, and precision, with special handling for Oracle-specific types and the Quercus environment.
